selection_or_interface: Exact Powerpole model/housing orientation/contacts, mating polarity, crimp tool, conductor gauge/length and all DC fuse/holder ratings remain TBD; validate actual assemblies with DMM, never color/family appearance alone. Include source-positive master fuse close to battery and independent branch fuse locations for CM5 5 V converter, motor power/NC E-stop cutoff path, and RF PA. Candidate upstream EMI treatment after master fuse: common-mode choke in both DC conductors, appropriately coordinated TVS and reverse-polarity protection; optional damped branch LC plus local decoupling DNP pending converter stability/vendor criteria and bench evidence. Specify choke/inductor low DCR, continuous/inrush current, saturation, thermal and impedance performance; TVS stand-off/clamp/energy and reverse-protection ratings; branch-fuse normal/inrush/current and DC voltage/interrupt/time-current curve against prospective fault current. All values, part models, wire/contact/holder ampacity and lengths remain TBD; external battery BMS is not a fuse.
assembly_notes: Battery is physically disconnected and all fuses removed during wiring. Cold-test continuity/isolation/actual polarity with DMM and NC stop safety chain; branch fuses removed while wiring, validated branch fuses installed after cold checks, source/master fuse LAST with battery disconnected, then reconnect battery only with station disconnect open and TX inhibited. Never rely on connector color/family for polarity. Include rigid battery restraint, terminal protection and strain relief at Powerpole/panel inlet. Validate converter startup/load-step stability and EMI with candidate LC DNP first; only populate reviewed damping networks after measurements. Count station-side filters/harness/connectors/fuses/strain relief in station mass.
